_about_file: Markup of the mcp-for-blender components for our pipeline. Their code is not modified: their blender_scripts.py and addon.py are placed unmodified in core/ext/mcp4b/, and the adapter mcp4b.py calls only the components with the status on and patch. Statuses: on — called as is; patch — called, with our patches around the call in the adapter; ours — their code is absent or unsuitable, and we have our own piece built on their idea; later — needed later, switched off for now; off — not taken. The check numbers come from the reference run notes; the steps e1–e18 are experiments, and eN in bench are the steps of the reference run bench.sh. Skills — numbers 1–21 of the capability list, classes — A1–D5 of the task classes; an empty list for infrastructure (it serves everyone).

_source.within_ext: core/ext/mcp4b/ (blender_scripts.py, addon.py unmodified; the adapter mcp4b.py and this markup are next to them; the path to their code is the MCP4B_SRC variable)
